attack.note: Almost all damage is Frostbolt, Blizzard and Cone of Cold. Only Icefury Wand builds lean on basic attacks, and Cone of Cold has the shortest range of her kit.

poke.note: Frostbolt is a four second cooldown projectile that slows, so poke comes in bursts rather than constantly. Blizzard is delayed and easy to walk out of unless the target is rooted or slowed.

damage.note: Frostbite makes Chilled targets take 50 percent more ability damage, so a Frostbolt, Cone of Cold and Blizzard chain is a short burst that kills through most heals. Measured 2372 hero damage per minute is below other assassins because it comes in bursts, with 5075 siege, which is above the median.

good_into.why: Every ability chills, so melee heroes are slowed, and Numbing Blast with Ice Floes and Ring of Frost roots them in range of her team.
Blizzard waves are delayed and Ring of Frost is a circle, both of which hit heroes that cannot step out of them.
Chilled burst of Cone of Cold (220) and Blizzard with Northern Exposure armor shred kills fragile targets that a team has caught.
Every ability chills, so a hero that tries to kite or run is slowed 25 percent, and Blizzard waves cast along the slowed path land.

bad_into.why: She has almost no mobility and only Ice Block (after a 12000 damage quest) or Ice Blink at level 20 to survive a dive.
Jaina is fragile and needs her whole combo, so one fast jump on her ends the fight before her cooldowns are used.
Blizzard and Ring of Frost are delayed, so fast heroes simply walk out of them.
Several long range heroes such as Junkrat or Hanzo outrange her Frostbolt, and Icy Veins says Winter's Reach is needed to pressure them.

wants_from_team: a tank that peels and sets up crowd control for Blizzard and Ring of Frost
allied roots, stuns or pulls to let delayed abilities land
a healer, since she has only one short invulnerability
teammates who follow her burst, because Frostbite amplifies all of their ability damage
gives_team: wave clear that frees teammates to rotate
area slow on every ability that helps allies catch targets
Northern Exposure armor reduction that raises team burst
Ring of Frost root that sets up allied combos
weaknesses: almost every ability can be dodged or blocked
her best defense depends on a 12000 damage quest
long cooldowns must be managed carefully
evidence: measured damage 2372 per minute and siege 5075 per minute

lens_notes.damage_timing: Frostbolt, Cone of Cold and Blizzard chain into a short burst on chilled targets, then long cooldowns.
lens_notes.durability_source: Ice Block is an untargetable window but needs the 12000 damage quest.
lens_notes.kill_pattern: Slows from every ability and Ring of Frost let teammates and her own burst finish a target.
lens_notes.escape: Ice Block quest or Ice Blink at level 20 only.
lens_notes.setup_reliance: Blizzard and Ring of Frost are delayed, so she wants allied roots and stuns.
lens_notes.cc_profile: Ring of Frost (heroic) and Numbing Blast root; everything else slows. Scored single hard because the root is a heroic.
lens_notes.ultimate_role: Summon Water Elemental is the go to heroic per Icy Veins because it needs no setup; Ring of Frost is the fight pick into melee comps.
lens_notes.camp_play: Blizzard clears camps fast, 5.1 camps per game measured.

lens_gaps: no value for 'slows with every ability' (a team slow lens) on cc_profile or team_gives
ultimate_role has no value for a summon that does damage and siege together
